rules.description: Fresh applications that are duly verified and received on or before 30 September 2017 are eligible and will be considered for merit list preparation and subsequent lot generation.
rules.condition: Application is fresh, duly verified, and received by 30 September 2017.
rules.outcome: The application is treated as an Eligible Application and included in merit list preparation and lot generation.
rules.evidence_quote: Duly verified Fresh applications received up to 30th September, 2017 for all schemes will be treated as Eligible Applications and considered for Merit list preparation and thereafter lot generation.
